title: お正月 (Oshogatsu — New Year)
description: A beloved New Year's children's song about traditional holiday games: kite flying, spinning tops, ball bouncing, and battledore shuttlecock. Still sung every January in Japanese schools and households. Composed in 1900 for the 幼稚園唱歌 (kindergarten songbook). Lyrics by 東くめ (Higashi Kume, d. 1952), music by 瀧廉太郎 (Taki Rentaro, d. 1903).
license: Public Domain (Lyrics by 東くめ d. 1952, music by 瀧廉太郎 d. 1903; published 1900 in 幼稚園唱歌 — both copyrights expired under 50-year rule before Japan's 2018 extension)
